training_implementation.input: CSE-CIC-IDS2018 CICFlowMeter flow CSVs (pre-computed by the dataset authors)

window_semantics.interval: [t, t+10) — left-closed, right-open (floor semantics on both sides)
window_semantics.origin: epoch-aligned multiples of 10 s in both paths (floor of an absolute timestamp)
window_semantics.row_assignment: a flow belongs to the window of its START time (CIC Timestamp / first packet), and ALL of its statistics are attributed to that window
window_semantics.rounding: floor, never round-half; no tolerance band
window_semantics.ordering: groupby(..., sort=True) in training; groupby('window_idx', sort=True) in the PCAP path
window_semantics.empty_windows: produce NO row in either path — the window simply does not exist. Downstream, the 10-second contiguity gate rejects any sequence spanning the gap (np.all(diffs == 10) in prepare_multiday_benchmark.py, mirrored by build_sequences in pcap_ingest_v4.py).
window_semantics.first_window: kept as-is; its relative-change row is forced to 0.0
window_semantics.last_window: kept as-is; sequences needing K future targets simply are not formed

timezone.training: naive local timestamps parsed from the CIC CSV Timestamp column; no tz conversion is applied anywhere in the training path
timezone.pcap: absolute UTC epoch seconds from the capture
timezone.note: Both floor to 10 s multiples, so bin WIDTH and boundary RULE are identical, but the two paths are not anchored to the same clock. The CSE-CIC-IDS2018 CSV clock is Atlantic local with the AM/PM marker dropped, which cannot be reconciled with UTC epoch bins without an explicit offset. This matters only when aligning a PCAP window to a dataset window; it does not change any feature value.

safe_log1p.definition: to_numeric(errors='coerce') -> replace(+/-inf, NaN) -> fillna(0.0) -> clip(lower=0.0) -> log1p
safe_log1p.applied: AFTER window aggregation, BEFORE relative change

entropy_from_counts.definition: Shannon entropy base 2 of value_counts(dropna=True); p + 1e-12 inside the log; returns 0.0 when <= 1 distinct value

flag_rate.definition: flag_count / (total_packets + 1e-8) per flow, then mean over flows

nan_inf_handling_state.definition: the 26 base features are replace([inf,-inf], NaN).fillna(0.0) before leaving the builder
nan_inf_handling_state.training: create_network_states_v2.py final numerical validation + prepare_multiday_benchmark.py df[STATE_FEATURES].replace([inf,-inf], NaN).fillna(0.0)
nan_inf_handling_state.applied: AFTER window aggregation, BEFORE relative change

relative_change_semantics.previous_state: the immediately preceding ROW of the state table, i.e. the previous existing 10-second window — NOT necessarily t-10 s when a window is missing
relative_change_semantics.missing_previous: the first row is forced to exactly 0.0 (rel.iloc[0] = 0.0)
relative_change_semantics.zero_denominator: handled by the +1e-8 epsilon, not by masking; a 0 -> x change yields a very large ratio which is then clipped
relative_change_semantics.log_order: computed on the ALREADY log-transformed base features — the log is applied during window aggregation, the relative change afterwards

reset_scope.training: per SOURCE DAY: prepare_multiday_benchmark.py computes relative changes inside load_and_prep_day BEFORE the train/val split, so day boundaries reset the chain
reset_scope.pcap: per CAPTURE: add_relative_changes runs on the window table of one pcap file
reset_scope.note: Both reset at the boundary of one contiguous capture/day unit and never carry a relative change across that boundary.

scaler_semantics.fitted_on: the TRAIN partition only (8,575 windows for the frozen benchmark); rotated folds each fit their own scaler on their own train partition
scaler_semantics.applied_training: prepare_multiday_benchmark.py, at dataset build time, BEFORE sequence construction
scaler_semantics.applied_pcap: pcap_ingest_v4.build_sequences, on a DataFrame reindexed to the canonical column names so sklearn validates the order, BEFORE sequence construction
scaler_semantics.other_transforms: none — no PCA, no whitening, no feature selection anywhere in either path

features.name: flow_count
features.training_formula: grouped.agg(flow_count=("Timestamp", "size")) — number of CICFlowMeter flow rows whose Timestamp floors into the window
features.pcap_formula: g.agg(flow_count=("window_idx", "size")) — number of reconstructed flows whose FIRST packet falls in the window
features.parity_note: CICFlowMeter terminates flows on FIN/RST and a 120 s timeout; the PCAP path splits a 5-tuple only on a >120 s idle gap, so one CIC flow may map to a different number of reconstructed flows. Capture scope also differs (whole victim subnet vs the hosts actually captured).

features.name: log_flow_count
features.parity_note: inherits flow_count

features.name: log_total_packets
features.training_formula: safe_log1p(sum over flows of (Tot Fwd Pkts + Tot Bwd Pkts))
features.pcap_formula: _safe_log1p(sum over flows of tot_pkts), tot_pkts = packets attributed to the reconstructed flow
features.parity_note: inherits the flow-segmentation and capture-scope difference

features.name: log_total_bytes
features.training_formula: safe_log1p(sum over flows of (TotLen Fwd Pkts + TotLen Bwd Pkts))
features.pcap_formula: _safe_log1p(sum over flows of total_bytes), total_bytes = sum of L4 payload lengths
features.parity_note: CICFlowMeter TotLen counts packet lengths as its engine defines them; the PCAP path sums L4 payload bytes. Same concept (bytes in window), different byte accounting.

features.name: window_packet_rate
features.training_formula: states['total_packets'] / WINDOW_SECONDS (window totals, not CIC per-flow rate fields)
features.parity_note: inherits total_packets

features.name: window_byte_rate
features.parity_note: inherits total_bytes

features.name: syn_rate
features.training_formula: per flow: SYN Flag Cnt / (total_packets + 1e-8); then mean over flows in the window. In the CIC CSVs the "* Flag Cnt" columns are BOOLEAN (0/1).
features.pcap_formula: per flow: int(any SYN in flow) / (tot_pkts + 1e-8); then mean over flows
features.parity_note: Definition matches (binarised flag over flow packet count). Measured distributions still differ materially: the binarised definition is highly sensitive to flow length, and reconstructed flows are shorter than CICFlowMeter's.

features.name: ack_rate
features.training_formula: per flow: ACK Flag Cnt / (total_packets + 1e-8); mean over flows
features.pcap_formula: per flow: int(any ACK) / (tot_pkts + 1e-8); mean over flows
features.parity_note: as syn_rate

features.name: rst_rate
features.training_formula: per flow: RST Flag Cnt / (total_packets + 1e-8); mean over flows
features.pcap_formula: per flow: int(any RST) / (tot_pkts + 1e-8); mean over flows
features.parity_note: as syn_rate

features.name: fin_rate
features.training_formula: per flow: FIN Flag Cnt / (total_packets + 1e-8); mean over flows
features.pcap_formula: per flow: int(any FIN) / (tot_pkts + 1e-8); mean over flows
features.parity_note: as syn_rate; measured divergence is largest here because flow-termination semantics differ

features.name: psh_rate
features.training_formula: per flow: PSH Flag Cnt / (total_packets + 1e-8); mean over flows
features.pcap_formula: per flow: int(any PSH) / (tot_pkts + 1e-8); mean over flows
features.parity_note: as syn_rate

features.name: urg_rate
features.training_formula: per flow: URG Flag Cnt / (total_packets + 1e-8); mean over flows
features.pcap_formula: per flow: int(any URG) / (tot_pkts + 1e-8); mean over flows
features.parity_note: as syn_rate

features.name: mean_pkt_len
features.training_formula: mean over flows of the CIC per-flow column "Pkt Len Mean" (mean of a mean, not a pooled mean)
features.pcap_formula: mean over flows of pkt_len_mean, where pkt_len_mean = mean L4 payload length of the flow
features.parity_note: same mean-of-per-flow-mean structure; byte basis differs (CIC packet length vs L4 payload)

features.name: std_pkt_len
features.training_formula: mean over flows of the CIC per-flow column "Pkt Len Std" (mean of per-flow std, NOT a pooled std)
features.pcap_formula: mean over flows of pkt_len_std = sample std (ddof=1) of the flow's L4 payload lengths
features.parity_note: same structure; byte basis differs

features.name: log_mean_flow_duration
features.training_formula: safe_log1p(mean over flows of "Flow Duration") — CICFlowMeter Flow Duration is in MICROSECONDS
features.pcap_formula: _safe_log1p(mean over flows of flow_duration_us) — (last-first packet time) * 1e6, MICROSECONDS
features.parity_note: units aligned (µs); the value differs because flow lifetimes differ between engines

features.name: log_mean_fwd_iat
features.training_formula: safe_log1p(mean over flows of "Fwd IAT Mean") — MICROSECONDS
features.pcap_formula: _safe_log1p(mean over flows of fwd_iat_mean_us) — mean diff of forward packet times * 1e6
features.parity_note: units aligned; residual divergence measured

features.name: log_mean_bwd_iat
features.training_formula: safe_log1p(mean over flows of "Bwd IAT Mean") — MICROSECONDS
features.parity_note: units aligned

features.name: fwd_packet_ratio
features.training_formula: per flow: safe_divide(Tot Fwd Pkts, total_packets); mean over flows
features.pcap_formula: per flow: _safe_divide(tot_fwd_pkts, tot_pkts); mean over flows, forward = direction of the flow's FIRST packet
features.parity_note: identical formula and identical initiator-direction convention; values differ because flow segmentation differs

features.name: bwd_packet_ratio
features.training_formula: per flow: safe_divide(Tot Bwd Pkts, total_packets); mean over flows
features.pcap_formula: per flow: _safe_divide(tot_bwd_pkts, tot_pkts); mean over flows
features.parity_note: as fwd_packet_ratio

features.name: fwd_byte_ratio
features.training_formula: per flow: safe_divide(TotLen Fwd Pkts, total_bytes); mean over flows
features.pcap_formula: per flow: _safe_divide(totlen_fwd, total_bytes); mean over flows
features.parity_note: as fwd_packet_ratio

features.name: bwd_byte_ratio
features.training_formula: per flow: safe_divide(TotLen Bwd Pkts, total_bytes); mean over flows
features.pcap_formula: per flow: _safe_divide(totlen_bwd, total_bytes); mean over flows
features.parity_note: as fwd_packet_ratio

features.name: mean_down_up_ratio
features.training_formula: mean over flows of the CIC column "Down/Up Ratio" (integer-valued in the training CSVs)
features.pcap_formula: mean over flows of down_up_ratio = int(n_bwd // n_fwd), 0 when n_fwd == 0
features.expected_unit: dimensionless integer ratio, averaged over flows
features.parity_note: both integer-valued per flow; CIC's exact integer rule is not published

features.name: log_unique_dst_ports
features.training_formula: safe_log1p(nunique of "Dst Port" over the flows in the window)
features.pcap_formula: _safe_log1p(nunique of dst_port over the flows in the window)
features.parity_note: identical formula; strongly capture-scope dependent

features.name: unique_protocols
features.training_formula: nunique of "Protocol" over the flows in the window
features.pcap_formula: nunique of protocol over the flows in the window
features.parity_note: identical formula; scope dependent

features.name: dst_port_entropy
features.training_formula: entropy_from_counts(Dst Port): Shannon base-2 over value_counts, p + 1e-12, 0.0 when <= 1 distinct value
features.pcap_formula: _entropy_from_counts(dst_port): verbatim port of the same function
features.parity_note: identical formula; scope dependent

features.name: protocol_entropy
features.parity_note: identical formula; scope dependent

parity_vocabulary.EXACT: same computational definition and identical implementation behaviour
parity_vocabulary.APPROXIMATE: same conceptual definition; implementation differences remain, numerical equality not guaranteed
